moments.title: 🇺🇸 I’m not sure there has ever been a table quite like the one Trump assembled at the White House today. Elon on his left. Jensen Huang on his right. Zuckerberg, Pichai, Bezos and many of the people actually building the
moments.selftext: 🇺🇸 I’m not sure there has ever been a table quite like the one Trump assembled at the White House today. Elon on his left. Jensen Huang on his right. Zuckerberg, Pichai, Bezos and many of the people actually building the AI economy around them. And Trump’s message to the room was remarkably simple: “We have a very big lead, and we’re gonna keep our lead.” Washington now explicitly talks about AI as national power. Trump says it could become bigger than the Industrial Revolution, and he increasingly describes the competition with China as one with a winner and no meaningful second place. A week after Xi sat down with many of these same technology leaders, they’re back in Washington together. I think we’re watching Silicon Valley become part of American statecraft in real time. Writer: Oliver

moments.title: Henry Malukas, co-founder of HMD Trucking, which operates a fleet of ~700 diesel semi trucks, says the company has ordered 50 @Tesla Semi trucks. "It’s an amazing product. It’s efficient, low maintenance, also the fuel c
moments.selftext: Henry Malukas, co-founder of HMD Trucking, which operates a fleet of ~700 diesel semi trucks, says the company has ordered 50 @Tesla Semi trucks. "It’s an amazing product. It’s efficient, low maintenance, also the fuel cost. It's unbelievable. And for the driver, I think it’s a dream come true. Yeah, it’s like nothing we’ve ever seen, and I don’t think anybody is going to see for a while, anything like that. It’s just going to be next level,” said Malukas. "It works for a long haul; any kind of trucking, for any kind of use; it’s going to be electric. I think for the [electric] cars, when they came out, people had a preference; they had their emotional attachments. Here, when this rolls out to businesses, when they understand what it does, and the costs and all that stuff, that will take off in the market because there are no emotions. The owners of the company look at the bottom line, and we’re going to excel at the next level. I mean, this is a miracle in my eyes. I test drove the thing, and it’s a dream. This is a game changer that’s coming, 100 percent. And I hope everybody else will catch up to give Tesla some competition. But right now, everybody is far behind,” said Malukas.

moments.selftext: GOLDMAN: GULF OIL EXPORTS FULLY RECOVER TO 2025 LEVELS Persian Gulf oil exports have doubled in September, reaching 23.3 million barrels per day, according to Goldman Sachs. Crude shipments have recovered to 108% of their 2025 average, but key refined products, including diesel and jet fuel, remain at just 50% amid refinery outages and shipping risks. Goldman sees the global oil market roughly balanced and maintains its $85 Brent forecast for year-end.
